tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Verbex guides and templates: practical guides (protocols and SOPs, lab notebooks, inventory, data integrity and GLP, equipment records, bench calculations) and the 16 lab documentation templates. Returns ids to pass to fetch, with titles and urls to cite. Not for calculations: to compute a ma

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get the full text of a search result by id, as Markdown. Guides come with a short summary; templates include the blank template, a worked example where there is one, and a link to the editable Word or Excel file. Calculators return the method, the input fields and a worked example computed by the ca

tools.name: solution_prep
tools.description: Use when someone asks how much solid to weigh for a molar solution (how many grams for X mM in Y mL, making up a buffer or salt solution), or how much stock to dilute to a target concentration (C1V1). mode "solid": mass of solid to weigh from molecular weight, target concentration and final volume.

tools.name: serial_dilution
tools.description: Use for any serial dilution (standard curves, titrations, dose series). Plans transfer and diluent volume per tube and the resulting concentration at each step, from a stock concentration, a constant dilution factor, the number of tubes and the final volume per tube.

tools.name: pcr_master_mix
tools.description: Use when someone sets up a PCR or qPCR reaction mix for several wells. Calculates volume of each component per reaction and for the whole mix with excess, with water filling the remaining volume. Give each component a stock and final concentration (molar, ng/µL, x buffer, %), an amount per reaction

tools.name: lnp_formulation
tools.description: Plan a lipid nanoparticle (LNP) formulation for RNA: from RNA mass, N/P ratio and lipid mol% (e.g. ionizable lipid/DSPC/cholesterol/PEG-lipid 50/10/38.5/1.5), calculate moles, mass and stock volume of every lipid, the ethanol and aqueous phase volumes at the chosen mixing ratio (default 3:1), and fi

tools.name: plate_map
tools.description: Use when someone lays out a multiwell plate (ELISA, qPCR, cell or compound assays). Lays out a 6, 12, 24, 48, 96 or 384-well plate: standards, samples, controls and blanks with replicates, filled by row or column, optionally leaving edge wells empty and keeping replicate sets together. Returns a gri

tools.name: protocol_template
tools.description: Build a structured lab protocol (purpose, materials, procedure, critical steps, acceptance criteria and more) for a protocol title, using a preset or custom sections. Returns Markdown and HTML ready to fill in or print.

tools.name: eln_template
tools.description: Build an electronic lab notebook (ELN) entry template for an experiment: objective, materials, procedure, observations and conclusion sections from a preset or custom list, optionally with timestamp fields and voice-capture prompts. Returns Markdown and HTML.

tools.name: parse_reagent_label
tools.description: Turn text read from a reagent bottle or kit label (OCR or typed) into structured fields such as product name, catalog number, lot, expiry, concentration and storage. Parses the provided text only; send the label text, not an image.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, eln_template · Private data: search, fetch · Public sink: parse_reagent_label.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, eln_template · Private data: search, fetch · Public sink: parse_reagent_label

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
